description: Chintu aur Mithu raat mein taaron ke saath khel rahe hain. Is gaane se bachhe raat ke nazaron aur jaanwaron ki awaazon ke baare mein seekhenge.
learning: Learning about the night sky, counting stars, and identifying animal sounds.
